dhruva.general.heading: General Jyotish Questions
dhruva.general.kundaliAnswer: A Kundali is a birth chart that maps the sky for a specific birth time and place. HoraLife uses it as the base for later chart calculations.
dhruva.general.ascendantAnswer: Ascendant, or Lagna, is the sign rising on the eastern horizon at birth. It is used as the starting point for reading houses.
dhruva.general.nakshatraAnswer: A Nakshatra is one of the lunar mansions used in Jyotish. It gives a finer reference for the Moon position and related timing systems.
dhruva.general.dashaAnswer: Dasha is a planetary period system in Jyotish. It helps organize when different planetary themes are considered active.
dhruva.general.mahadashaAntardashaAnswer: Mahadasha is the larger planetary period. Antardasha is a smaller period running inside it, adding more specific timing context.
dhruva.general.yogaAnswer: A Yoga is a named planetary combination. It should be understood from calculated chart data and the full chart context.
dhruva.general.doshaAnswer: A Dosha is a chart condition that may need careful reading. It should not be read with fear or judged in isolation.

kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.career: Work and recognition have more backing than usual. This is a better window to be visible, take responsibility, and let effort be noticed.
Career has both lift and friction. Grow where people already see your work, and stay patient where results lag.
Career may feel slower or heavier. Protect your name, finish what you started, and avoid rushed job moves.
Career is not loudly activated. Keep a steady routine until a clearer chapter begins.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.financ: Money flow and gains have more support. A good window to organise income, collect dues, and make planned financial moves.
Some income paths open while others need caution. Spend on what is necessary, and delay risky bets.
Money may feel tight or delayed. Protect savings, avoid impulsive spending, and track every commitment.
Finances are relatively quiet. Keep accounts clean and wait for a clearer money chapter.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.relati: Close bonds have more ease. A better window to talk honestly, repair trust, or take a relationship step you already know is right.
Closeness and misunderstanding can arrive together. Slow down reactions, and say what you mean without rushing decisions.
Partnerships may feel tested. Give space where needed, avoid ultimatums, and protect dignity on both sides.
Relationship themes are not strongly pushed. Keep ordinary care and do not force a turning point.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.educat: Learning and skill-building have more support. A good window for study, exams, courses, or teaching what you know.
Study can progress, but focus may waver. Shorter sessions and a clear plan will work better than cramming.
Learning may feel slow or interrupted. Reduce overload, revise basics, and do not judge your ability by this stretch alone.
Education is not the loudest theme right now. Keep a light study habit if you need continuity.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.family: Home and family support are easier to feel. A better window to spend time with family, settle home matters, or ask for help.
Family care and family pressure can both be present. Help where you can, and keep one healthy boundary.
Family duties may feel heavy. Do the necessary support, avoid old arguments, and rest when you can.
Family life is relatively steady. Keep ordinary care without forcing a big family decision.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.proper: Home and property matters have more support. A better window to repair, plan a move, or settle papers you already started.
Property plans can move, but delays are likely. Check documents twice and do not rush a signature.
House or land matters may stall or need extra care. Avoid hasty deals and get paperwork reviewed.
Property themes are quiet. Maintain what you have until a clearer window opens.
kundali.predictions.plain.meaning.health: Energy and recovery have more support. Keep routines that already work — sleep, food, and movement.
Vitality can rise and dip. Do not ignore tiredness; keep habits simple and consistent.
The body may ask for more rest and discipline. Reduce strain, keep medical follow-up if needed, and do not push through exhaustion.
Health is not strongly highlighted. Keep ordinary care and regular rest.
